entities.summary: Ihor Volodymyrovych Bedzai was a Ukrainian naval officer and pilot killed when his helicopter was shot down by invading Russian forces during the Russian invasion of Ukraine. He was also the Deputy Commander of the Ukrainian Navy. He was a posthumously awarded the title of Hero of Ukraine as a recipient of the Order of the Gold Star, and the knight of the Order of Bohdan Khmelnytsky III class.
